caption: The drawing depicts a cast iron stove with intricate decorative patterns on its sides and front panel. The stove stands on four legs that are shaped to resemble animal paws. The front of the stove features a rectangular door with an arched top, equipped with a latch and handle, and includes raised lettering and linear details. There is a circular opening at the top for a chimney or stovepipe. An oval plate extends from the lower front area, serving as a hearth or ash catcher, and is supported by two of the stove’s legs. The entire stove appears to be a solid, dark color consistent with cast iron, and the surface is covered with raised ornamental motifs, including circular and arch-like designs. The background of the image is plain and light in color, providing contrast to the dark stove, and there are no other objects visible in the composition.
title: Box Stove
